title: How do World Models and Policies Compose in LLM Agents? A Joint Spectral and Behavioral Account
abstract: arXiv:2608.30067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How do LLM agents come to both understand environments they act in and master tasks set within them? Through controlled experiments combining world-model training (next-state prediction) and policy training (reward maximization), we investigate this question. We dissect the resulting models through their additive parameter updates. Geometrically, we find effective world-model updates are low-rank and share an input-feature subspace with policy updates while writing to nearly orthogonal output directions, whether trained separately or sequentially. However, we find that, in projection interventions, the sequential update induces more robustness than separate policy RL when removing the world model's leading input directions, suggesting that it has learned alternative input pathways. translated_title: LLM智能体中世界模型与策略如何组合？一个谱与行为的联合分析
translated_abstract: LLM智能体如何既能理解其所处的环境，又能掌握环境中设定的任务？我们通过结合世界模型训练（下一状态预测）与策略训练（奖励最大化）的受控实验来研究这一问题。我们通过加性参数更新对训练所得的模型进行剖析。在几何层面上，我们发现有效的世界模型更新是低秩的，并且与策略更新共享一个输入特征子空间，同时写入几乎正交的输出方向——无论是分开训练还是顺序训练均是如此。然而，我们发现在投影干预实验中，当移除世界模型的主要输入方向时，顺序更新比单独的策略强化学习表现出更强的鲁棒性，这表明它学到了替代的输入通路。在行为层面上，我们发现顺序训练的智能体探索了更广泛的状态和动作范围。基于此，我们进一步提出问题：策略训练是否保留了世界模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过谱（几何）与行为的联合分析发现，LLM智能体中世界模型与策略的参数更新共享输入特征子空间但输出方向近乎正交，且顺序训练相比单独策略训练能学到替代输入通路并探索更广泛的状态-动作空间。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through joint spectral and behavioral analysis that world-model and policy updates in LLM agents share an input-feature subspace while writing to nearly orthogonal output directions, and that sequential training induces alternative input pathways and broader state-action exploration than separate policy RL.
